doc.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01

title: Emile Barnes on playing with Buddy Petit and Joe Oliver in the brass band
summary: Emile recalls working with Buddy Petit's band outside the city, naming the bandmates; Russell then asks about Joe Oliver in the brass band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
